title: Trace System + trace session Commands
description: Implement the complete named-session trace infrastructure: TraceEntry records, TraceWriter (append-only JSONL with Authorization exclusion), TraceSession (sessions.json index with file-locked seq counter), TraceExporter (JSONL → JSON array with optional filters), passive auto-append in ApiClient, and all five trace session subcommands.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1-5 complete. ApiClient is deployed and working. IOutputWriter wired. No trace infrastructure exists yet.
goal: After 'zapi-cli trace session start --name my-session', every subsequent api call automatically appends a trace entry to trace.jsonl with the Authorization header excluded. 'zapi-cli trace session export --name my-session' returns the complete call log as a JSON array. Sessions survive process exits.
scope: Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/TraceEntry.cs with ApiTraceEntry and PexTraceEntry sealed records exactly as defined in tech_spec.md §5 Data Models. ApiTraceEntry fields: Seq (int), Type ('api' constant), Session (required string), Timestamp (required DateTimeOffset), DurationMs (int), Account (required string), Method (required string), BaseUrl (required string — scheme+host+port only, no path), Url (required string — full URL), RequestHeaders (Dictionary<string,string> — Authorization EXCLUDED), RequestBody (string?), ResponseStatus (int), ResponseHeaders (Dictionary<string,string>), ResponseBody (string?), Error (string?). PexTraceEntry fields: Seq, Type ('pex'), Session, Timestamp, Account, RelatedApiSeq (int?), HandlerClass (required string), CallbackMethod (required string), Payload (required string).

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/TraceSession.cs: manages sessions.json at <configDir>/traces/sessions.json. Internal model: TraceSessionEntry sealed record with Name, StartTime (DateTimeOffset), EntryCount (int), Status ('active'|'closed'). Methods: Task<string?> GetActiveSessionNameAsync(ct); Task StartSessionAsync(string name, ct) — validates name (see OQ-009), throws if name already exists; Task CloseSessionAsync(string name, ct); Task RemoveSessionAsync(string name, ct) — deletes sessions.json entry AND the <session-name>/ directory; Task<IReadOnlyList<TraceSessionEntry>> ListSessionsAsync(ct); Task<int> IncrementEntryCountAsync(string name, ct) — returns new seq; uses named Mutex for concurrency (see OQ-010).
Session name validation in StartSessionAsync: allow only [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], max 64 chars; throw ZapiCliException(INVALID_ARGS, 1) if invalid.

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/TraceWriter.cs: constructor injects ITraceSession, ILogger<TraceWriter>. Methods: Task AppendApiEntryAsync(ApiTraceEntry entry, ct), Task AppendPexEntryAsync(PexTraceEntry entry, ct). Implementation: (1) GetActiveSessionNameAsync — if null, return silently; (2) IncrementEntryCountAsync for seq; (3) Write one serialized JSON line to <configDir>/traces/<session-name>/trace.jsonl (append mode, create dir if needed); (4) Authorization key is explicitly REMOVED from entry.RequestHeaders before serialization — this must happen in TraceWriter, not in ApiClient. All failures caught and logged at Warning level — never rethrow.
Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/ITraceSession.cs interface exposing the TraceSession contract for DI injection and testability.

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/TraceExporter.cs: Task<IReadOnlyList<JsonElement>> ExportAsync(string name, int? truncateBodyBytes, string? typeFilter, ct). Reads trace.jsonl line by line, deserializes each to JsonElement, applies optional typeFilter (api|pex), optionally truncates request_body and response_body string fields to truncateBodyBytes. Returns list. If session not found, throws ZapiCliException(ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND scoped to session context, with code SESSION_NOT_FOUND exit 1 — add SESSION_NOT_FOUND to ErrorCodes).

Integrate TraceWriter into ApiClient.CallAsync: inject ITraceWriter (interface) into ApiClient constructor. After receiving the response (success or caught exception), build ApiTraceEntry and call TraceWriter.AppendApiEntryAsync. The BaseUrl field = uri.GetLeftPart(UriPartial.Authority) (scheme + host + port, no path). Authorization must NEVER appear in the entry's RequestHeaders. Trace write failure must NOT propagate — catch and log only.
Add ITraceWriter interface to Core for DI.
Create src/ZapiCli/Commands/TraceCommands.cs with five command classes.

StartSessionSettings: [CommandOption("--name")] required string Name. StartSessionCommand.ExecuteAsync: calls TraceSession.StartSessionAsync; WriteJson({ status="ok", data = { name, start_time, status="active" } }).
ListSessionsCommand.ExecuteAsync: calls TraceSession.ListSessionsAsync; WriteJson the array of { name, start_time, entry_count, status } objects.

ExportSessionSettings: [CommandOption("--name")] required string Name, [CommandOption("--truncate-body")] int? TruncateBody, [CommandOption("--type")] string? Type. ExportSessionCommand.ExecuteAsync: calls TraceExporter.ExportAsync; IOutputWriter.WriteJson the resulting list.
CloseSessionSettings: [CommandOption("--name")] required string Name. CloseSessionCommand.ExecuteAsync: TraceSession.CloseSessionAsync; WriteJson({ status="ok", data = { name } }).

RemoveSessionSettings: [CommandOption("--name")] required string Name. RemoveSessionCommand.ExecuteAsync: TraceSession.RemoveSessionAsync (deletes dir + sessions.json entry); WriteJson({ status="ok", data = { name } }).
Register ITraceSession (TraceSession) and ITraceWriter (TraceWriter) as singletons in Program.cs DI. Register all five commands under 'trace session' in CommandApp.

Unit tests: Authorization absent from exported entries (TraceWriter strips it); session name validation rejects 'bad/name'; if no active session api call succeeds with no trace file created; export is non-destructive (trace.jsonl byte count unchanged after export); --truncate-body 50 truncates body fields in export output but trace.jsonl retains full content; session list returns correct entryCount; RemoveSession deletes the directory.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
trace session start --name test returns success; sessions.json entry created with status 'active'
api call after session start appends exactly one entry to trace.jsonl
Exported trace entry does NOT contain an 'authorization' key in request_headers
trace session export returns a JSON array; trace.jsonl byte count is identical before and after (non-destructive)
trace session export --type api returns only entries with type='api'
trace session export --truncate-body 100 truncates body fields in output; .jsonl file retains full content
trace session close marks session status='closed' in sessions.json; trace.jsonl preserved
trace session remove deletes sessions.json entry and the session directory including trace.jsonl
trace session start with invalid name (e.g. 'bad/name') → INVALID_ARGS, exit 1
api call when no session is active → proceeds normally, no trace file created, no error
Concurrent trace appends integrity maintained via Mutex (sessions.json entryCount correct)
TraceWriter failure (e.g. disk full) does NOT propagate to the api call result
contextForAgent: Read ADR-0008 if it exists (trace sessions design). The Authorization exclusion MUST be in TraceWriter.AppendApiEntryAsync — copy the RequestHeaders dictionary and remove 'authorization' (case-insensitive key) before serializing. The BaseUrl in ApiTraceEntry = uri.GetLeftPart(UriPartial.Authority) = scheme+host+port only (e.g. 'https://desk.zoho.com', not 'https://desk.zoho.com/api/v1'). Trace storage path: <configDir>/traces/ (NOT <configDir>/zapi-cli/traces/ — no extra subdirectory). Sessions file: <configDir>/traces/sessions.json. Session entries dir: <configDir>/traces/<session-name>/trace.jsonl. TraceWriter must inject ITraceSession (not the concrete class) for testability. The Mutex name for concurrent seq safety is 'Global\zapi-cli-trace-<sessionName>' (see OQ-010).

openItems.defaultAssumption: See OQ-009. Allow [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], max 64 chars. Throw ZapiCliException(INVALID_ARGS, 1) on violation.
See OQ-010. Named Mutex: 'Global\\zapi-cli-trace-<sessionName>'. WaitOne(2000) — if timeout, drop the entry silently. ReleaseMutex in finally.
Wrap all TraceWriter operations in try/catch. On any failure, log at Warning level. Never rethrow. The api call must complete successfully even if trace writing fails.
Add SESSION_NOT_FOUND to ErrorCodes with exit 1. Used by TraceExporter when the session name does not exist in sessions.json.
